instruction.name: xvftintrz.lu.d
instruction.description: Convert double-precision floating point elements in `a` to unsigned 64-bit integer, rounding towards zero.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftintrz.lu.d $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvftintrz.lu.d $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrz.lu.d $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
